statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-40372 (GHSA-9mv3-2cwr-p262) is an ASP.NET Core elevation of privilege issue in the Microsoft.AspNetCore.DataProtection NuGet package: versions 10.0.0 through 10.0.6 can accept forged protected payloads, such as authentication cookies, and let some protected payloads be decrypted. Microsoft lists the package as affected from 10.0.0 through 10.0.6 and fixed in 10.0.7, and says the copy in the ASP.NET Core shared framework is not affected (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-9mv3-2cwr-p262, https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/395, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/10.0/10.0.7/10.0.7.md). DHI dotnet10-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 10 for Linux from Microsoft's source release, and each build's version is the .NET runtime version it carries. Scanned all 264 packages of the twelve published builds (10.0.2-r0, 10.0.3-r0, 10.0.4-r0, 10.0.5-r0, 10.0.6-r0, 10.0.7-r0, 10.0.8-r0, 10.0.9-r0, 10.0.10-r0, 10.0.13-r0, 10.0.14-r0 and 10.0.15-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the files inside the nupkg and other zip archives they hold: dotnet10-runtime-artifacts in every build holds the Microsoft.AspNetCore.DataProtection nupkg at the build's own version, 10.0.2 to 10.0.6 in the first five builds and 10.0.7 or later from 10.0.7-r0 on. The range ends at 10.0.7-r0 because it is the first published build with the fixed package.
